title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Black Beauty
description: Based on Anna Sewell's novel about a horse in Victorian England and its often cruel treatment by various owners.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Fracture
description: A hotshot prosecutor (Ryan Gosling) squares off against a cunning engineer (Anthony Hopkins) who tried to murder his wife and is now defending himself in court.

title: Presumed Innocent
description: A married prosecutor (Harrison Ford) hires an attorney (Raul Julia) to defend him against charges of murdering his seductive colleague.

title: Revolution
description: A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

title: My Sister's Keeper
description: A girl (Abigail Breslin) who was conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister goes to court to seek emancipation and prevent further harvesting of her body tissue.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Her Alibi
description: A mystery writer (Tom Selleck) provides an alibi and a bedroom for a Romanian beauty (Paulina Porizkova) suspected of murder.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: Strange Brew
description: The Canadian McKenzie brothers (Dave Thomas, Rick Moranis) cork a beer-factory brewmeister (Max von Sydow) who's out to rule the world.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Lost & Found
description: To spend time with an attractive neighbor (Sophie Marceau), a man (David Spade) kidnaps her dog, which proceeds to swallow a valuable ring.

title: Collateral Damage
description: A Los Angeles firefighter (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels to Colombia to find the terrorist who killed his wife and son.

title: Executive Decision
description: A commando squad must conduct a midair assault upon a hijacked plane loaded with terrorists and a deadly nerve gas.

title: Little Children
description: A dissatisfied housewife (Kate Winslet) and the husband (Patrick Wilson) of a documentary filmmaker (Jennifer Connelly) have secret trysts while their spouses are at work.

title: The Spitfire Grill
description: A small-town businessman sends his mousy wife (Marcia Gay Harden) to watch the ex-convict waitress (Alison Elliott) running the local diner for her bedridden boss (Ellen Burstyn).

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: My Blue Heaven
description: Slick mob witness Vinnie (Steve Martin) hides out in suburbia with square FBI man Barney (Rick Moranis).

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.

title: The Prince of Pennsylvania
description: A teenager (Keanu Reeves) kidnaps his coal-miner father (Fred Ward), hoping his mother (Bonnie Bedelia) will sell their land for the ransom.

title: Pennies From Heaven
description: A sheet-music salesman (Steve Martin) escapes his wife, girlfriend (Bernadette Peters) and the Depression through his songs.

title: Michael Collins
description: An Irish freedom fighter (Liam Neeson) engineers the assassinations of British officials following the failed Easter Rising of 1916.

title: Over the Edge
description: A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Evil Mage Profion (Jeremy Irons) seeks Empress Savina's (Thora Birch) magic scepter in his quest to overtake the kingdom of Izmer for his group of magic users.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Mama's Boy
description: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

title: Tequila Sunrise
description: A narcotics officer (Kurt Russell) uses a woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) to catch his buddy, a big-time cocaine dealer (Mel Gibson) ready to retire.

title: Dark City
description: A demented genius (Kiefer Sutherland), a sympathetic detective and a group of ominous beings are drawn to an amnesiac (Rufus Sewell) accused of murder.
